parameters.name: CharacterType
parameters.description:
The architecture of the instance. For more information, see [Architecture overview](~~86132~~). Valid values:

* **logic**: cluster or read/write splitting architecture.
* **normal**: standard architecture (primary/secondary).

<props="china">If **EngineVersion** is set to **6.0**, this parameter does not support the value **logic**.</props>

parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description: The database type. Set the value to **Redis**.

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description: The major engine version of the instance. Valid values: **4.0**, **5.0**, **6.0**, and **7.0**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~473778~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: ParameterCategory
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query the account parameter template. Set the value to account.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID. You can invoke the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to obtain the resource group ID.
> You can also obtain the resource group ID in the console. Related operations, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).
